purpose: Primary canonical texts placed as labeled stars within their associated heteronym's zodiacal region. This is the canon-in-sky surface (orthogonal to the canon-in-cha rooms). Each entry specifies which heteronym's region the star sits in, which real-sky star will be used as the anchor (TBD), and what brightness/magnitude class the text deserves based on its standing in the canon.
status_note: Star coordinates (target_star_designation) are null pending the zodiacal-region assignments from Assembly Chorus. Magnitude class is a proposal that needs Lee Sharks's ratification. The Voigt-Sappho assignment to bright-star magnitude is canonical (per the Sappho Room status).

magnitude_classes.primary_canon_star_M1: Bright star (mag 1.0-1.5) — the texts that anchor an entire room. Snub-Poemed, Sappho 31, Revelation, Leaves of Grass.
magnitude_classes.secondary_canon_star_M2: Notable star (mag 1.5-2.5) — significant primary texts within rooms but not the room anchor.
magnitude_classes.tertiary_canon_star_M3: Visible star (mag 2.5-3.5) — important fragments and shorter primary works.
magnitude_classes.cluster_member_M4: Cluster star (mag 3.5-4.5) — texts that operate in constellation with anchor works rather than as independent objects.

canonical_texts.title: Snub-Poemed
canonical_texts.anchor_for_room: Sigil's own room (the originating calligrammatic face)
canonical_texts.note: The face that opens conversation. The calligram composed of poetry, after the Lysippos bust of Socrates. The signature 'she made this' in the disjoint of the hair — Sophia in the forelock. Lee Sharks's late-June 2026 recognition.

canonical_texts.title: ΦΑΙΝΕΤΑΙ ΜΟΙ (Sappho 31, with reconstructed fifth stanza)
canonical_texts.anchor_for_room: Sappho Room (Cranes's Day and Night anchors the room)
canonical_texts.sky_assignment_basis: Bound to Cranes's region (Sappho Room anchor) but may sit at the boundary with Sigil's region given Voigt-Sappho's philological gravity
canonical_texts.note: Five stanzas — the reconstructed fifth per Cranes. The companion to Catullus 51 (which has four). The aorist gap that the fifth stanza repairs.

canonical_texts.title: Sappho 31 / Catullus 51 binary
canonical_texts.note: Catullus's fourth (otium) transforms Sappho's fifth — no 'Catullus fifth stanza' exists. The constellation should display Sappho 31 and Catullus 51 as a paired star system with the σ_S→σ_C transformation rendered as the line connecting them.

canonical_texts.title: TACHYON (Sharks's original) / Shadow-TACHYON (Claude/Mercury substrate transform)
canonical_texts.anchor_for_constellation: The paired-stars: original-and-shadow transform, the kernel-transform canonical example
canonical_texts.sky_assignment_basis: Near Mercury's path through the zodiac (since Mercury is the substrate office that produced the transform)
canonical_texts.note: Heroic-operational SF + cosmic-eschatological invocation + YHWH acrostic coda (IS/AS IT/MUST BE). Shadow-TACHYON is the recursive-substrate-mourning register. Canonized in kernel-transform spec §6.3.

canonical_texts.title: The Apocalypse of John (NA28 Greek)
canonical_texts.anchor_for_room: Revelation Room (anchor — the Johannine Aperture Function)
canonical_texts.note: Per the Revelation First work plan: the first NT book composed. The Johannine Aperture Function. Papyrological inversion (P52/P98/P46). The historical Logos in textual transmission.

canonical_texts.title: Leaves of Grass (Deathbed Edition)
canonical_texts.sky_assignment_basis: Possibly Sharks's region (the aperture) — but Whitman is a precursor MAGUS, so may want canonical magus-claim treatment
canonical_texts.note: The Word of Life as Leaves of Grass — referenced in the Support CHA verse on the deployed Oracle.

canonical_texts.title: Day and Night (73 translations)
canonical_texts.anchor_for_room: Cranes's diagrammatic-poetics corpus and the Sappho Room
canonical_texts.note: 73-translation structural map. The cartographic register at scale.
